question: What does the Autel EVO Max 4N do when the control link is lost, and do incident reports match?

intake.focus: Autel EVO Max 4N lost control link behavior
intake.reason: Request guidance from manuals and incident reports on control link loss and whether incident reports align

brief.short_answer: FAA guidance: when a loss of control link occurs, try to reestablish the control link with the aircraft; if connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures and discontinue flight if inputs are not synchronized. Autel EVO Max 4N manual: the drone enters a reconnection state, continuously attempting to reestablish the ground control link; if reconnected within 10 seconds, control returns to the remote controller. If not reconnected within 10 seconds, the app displays “Aircraft disconnected” and the drone executes the preset Signal Loss Action; during automatic RTH it continues to attempt reconnect, and during manual flight it slows and hovers, then executes Signal Lost after disconnection.

claims.text: When a loss of control link occurs, FAA guidance says “Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft.”
claims.quote: Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft.

claims.text: If connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.
claims.quote: If connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.

claims.text: When control inputs are not synchronized or delayed, discontinue flight and/or avoid further flight operations until further inspection and testing of the control link between the ground control unit and the aircraft.
claims.quote: Discontinue flight and/or avoid further flight operations until further inspection and testing of the control link between the ground control unit and the aircraft.
conditions: control inputs not synchronized or delayed

claims.text: The drone will enter a reconnection state when the C2 (Command & Control) link is lost, continuously attempting to re-establish connection with the ground control station.
claims.quote: The drone will enter a reconnection state when the C2 (Command & Control) link is lost

claims.text: If the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller.
claims.quote: If the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller.

claims.text: If reconnection is not established within 10 seconds, the Autel Enterprise App will display the warning message “Aircraft disconnected.”, and the drone will execute the preset Signal Loss Action.
claims.quote: the Autel Enterprise App will display the warning message “Aircraft disconnected.”, and the drone will execute the preset Signal Loss Action

claims.text: During the execution of automatic RTH caused by signal loss, the drone will continue to attempt to reconnect.
claims.quote: During the execution of automatic RTH caused by signal loss, the drone will continue to attempt to reconnect.
conditions: automatic RTH triggered by signal loss

claims.text: During manual flight, upon losing connection, the drone will slow down and hover, then execute the Signal Lost behavior after the corresponding disconnection message is shown in the app.
claims.quote: During manual flight, upon losing connection, the drone will slow down and hover.

claims.text: The ASRS reporter says, 'Shortly after takeoff I completely lost control of the UAS'.
claims.quote: Shortly after takeoff I completely lost control of the UAS

claims.text: The ASRS reporter says, 'Platform continued to fly away from me while input into the controls to return'.
claims.quote: Platform continued to fly away from me while input into the controls to return

claims.text: The ASRS reporter says, 'All attempts of Return To Home features failed'.
claims.quote: All attempts of Return To Home features failed

claims.text: The ASRS reporter says, 'UAS Platform has not been located or recovered'.
claims.quote: UAS Platform has not been located or recovered

gaps.text: FAA guidance requires reestablishing control link after loss; Autel manual describes a reconnection state and automatic recovery actions.
Autel states automatic return if link restores within 10 seconds; FAA guidance does not specify automatic return behavior.
Autel's Signal Loss Action post disconnection may diverge from FAA's emergency/contingency procedures.
Manual flight: Autel slows and hovers then executes Signal Lost; FAA guidance emphasizes reestablishing link or discontinuing flight.
Unverified incident reports describe loss of control, failed RTH, and unrecovered platform.
Correlation between incident reports and Autel's documented behavior is unclear.
